commits.message:
Add seating_rows for sorted seating charts

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

after.rosterkit/seating.py:
# owner: platform
"""Seating charts built from a list of students."""

from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from typing import List, Sequence

# ---
def seating_rows(
    students: Sequence[Student], seats_per_row: int
) -> List[str]:
    """One text line per row, sorted by last name."""
    if seats_per_row <= 0:
        raise ProjectError("seats per row must be positive")
    if not students:
        raise ProjectError("no students to seat")
    ordered = sorted(
        students,
        key=lambda student: (
            student.last_name.casefold(),
            student.first_name.casefold()
        )
    )
    lines = []
    for start in range(0, len(ordered), seats_per_row):
        chunk = ordered[start:start + seats_per_row]
        names = " | ".join(
            item.display_name for item in chunk
        )
        number = start // seats_per_row + 1
        lines.append(f"Row {number}: {names}")
    return lines
